issue_context.title: tracking issue; bump pause to 3.10
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

i have a PR in progress to bump pause to 3.10 by adding a minor feature to the Windows container.
a -v flag, to be on par with the Linux variant,
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/125067

STEPS:
- [x] make changes to pause for 3.10
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/125067
- [x] building pause for Linux and Windows and promote the manifest list image
we should fix https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/125099 first, according to the slack discussion this is automatic 
https://github.com/kubernetes/k8s.io/pull/6840
- [x] update build/dependencies.yaml and build/pause/Makefile to be on pause 3.10, update all dependents
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/125112



### Why is this needed?

make the Windows pause binary have the same -v as the linux version.
allow kubeadm to perform the same `pause -v` simplified health check on both Linux and Windows.
currently does not work on Windows.

related to https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/125012

Slack thread:
https://kubernetes.slack.com/archives/C2C40FMNF/p1716463142249939
